metricSemantics.night-raids: distinct recorded attack dates overlapping 00:00 inclusive to 07:00 exclusive
metricSemantics.quiet-days: covered calendar dates with no recorded exact-city aerial attack in the final Time Machine attack backbone
metricSemantics.explosion-reports: Air-alarms.in.ua media/OSINT explosion reports attributed to the exact canonical city; not physical explosion count
metricSemantics.time-under-alert: net exact-city applicable air-alert duration summed across covered Europe/Kyiv calendar dates

coverageStatusMeaning.full: numeric value exists for every city/day in the Hero reporting period
coverageStatusMeaning.partial: some city/days are unknown; displayed sum contains only known observations
coverageStatusMeaning.none: no numeric observations exist for the city/metric in the Hero reporting period
